title: Dan Spitzer
text: Hello there! My name is Dan and I’m a PhD student in the WCNR. I study ecophysiology with a focus on grass microanatomy, but I have a real passion for teaching.

title: About
text: This website draft was created for ESS 523A, a super useful course for learning about coding in R.

title: Stuff I’ve Done
text:
